      • FeatureVector

        public FeatureVector​(Double amountDeviation,
                     Double velocity1h,
                     Double velocity24h,
                     Double distanceFromHome,
                     Double timeOfDayRisk,
                     Double merchantRiskScore,
                     Double deviceRiskScore,
                     Double behavioralAnomalyScore)
        All-args constructor.
        Parameters:
        amountDeviation - Deviation from typical transaction amount
        velocity1h - Transaction velocity in last 1 hour
        velocity24h - Transaction velocity in last 24 hours
        distanceFromHome - Distance from customer's home location
        timeOfDayRisk - Risk score based on transaction time
        merchantRiskScore - Risk score for the merchant
        deviceRiskScore - Risk score based on device information
        behavioralAnomalyScore - Score indicating behavioral anomalies
